notes: No personal names, dates, or places are mentioned in the colophon. The text contains only the work title (iti vikramacaritre mādhavānalakathā samāptā), an auspicious wish, a standard anonymous scribal disclaimer verse (yādṛṣṭa puṣṭakaṃ dṛṣṭvā...), and invocations of deities (śrīkṛṣṇa, śrīmādhva).
